modalities.evidence: structural T1-weighted magnetic resonance brain imaging data
questionnaire-assessed measurements of trait-like chronotype, sleep quality and daytime sleepiness

output.population: 136 young individuals (87 females; age range from 18 to 35 years old), excluding self-reported psychiatric or neurological conditions and current medication use
output.summary: Structural T1-weighted brain images of young healthy adults with questionnaire measures of chronotype, sleep quality, and daytime sleepiness; all sessions were scheduled in the evening to control time-of-day effects.
